Secondly, I will be tracking Chinese exports and foreign investment for signals as to how supply chains will evolve considering lower-than-expected US tariffs and third-country concerns about Chinese export surges. Lawrence****:** Stagnation in US manufacturing, how the rest of the world struggles to deal with Trump’s disruptive leadership, how China’s growing trade surpluses lead to protectionist responses, how AI investments sow the seeds of the next financial crisis. Of course, the BIG trade issue is what happens to US tariff policy once the Supreme Court rules on the Trump administration’s use of the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) to impose tariffs.

results.title: 10 healthcare predictions for 2026 from top investors | Fortune
results.content: # AI doctors will be good at science but bad at business, and big talk with little action means even higher drugs prices: 10 healthcare predictions for 2026 from top investors. Also, we think it is far from certain if AI will make our healthcare cost problem better or worse. We think this is made possible because the U.S. economy maintains its remarkable, AI-fueled buoyancy and Trump earns credit for the peaceful resolution of the Israel and Ukraine wars (we hope). We do think these products and features will be awesome complements within a broader organization to deliver care, provide better access and make a lot more possible between visits, monitoring, and hopefully decreasing overall episode of care costs. As a result, we expect the traditional “iron triangle” of cost, quality, and access in healthcare to bend, as AI makes it possible to apply clinical intelligence at scale rather than only through human labor.

results.title: Top 10 SaaStr AI Predictions for 2026
results.content: **The Prediction:** AI-native B2B companies will run sales teams that are 50% smaller than their predecessors while maintaining or increasing revenue. One leading AI dev tools company just closed a $4M+ annual deal where the Sales Engineer ran the entire relationship—the sales team’s only contribution was helping price the deal. **Sources:** ICONIQ Growth GTM Benchmarking Study 2025; SaaStr AI Agent Deployment Data; Replit Head of Sales Engineering (conversation); SaaStr internal pipeline data. **The Prediction:** The highest-performing B2B companies will have AI agents handling 40-60% of initial prospect and customer interactions by the end of the year. **Sources:** OpenAI compute margin data (The Information); Token cost analysis; SaaStr Fund portfolio company data; Mary Meeker AI Report. **The Prediction:** Companies will transform support from a $2M cost center to a $500K profit center using AI agents. **The Prediction:** Most AI companies will shift from pure seat-based pricing to token markup or hybrid models with seats + inference. **The Prediction:** Multiple $50B+ IPOs from AI and AI-native companies, dwarfing 2021.
